primary_history: previous arm-specific H fixed for A0/A1/A2
A0: exact old A.npz loaded with old scaler/coefficients; no re-selection
A1: full raw history plus sign/abs/difference/zero-crossing at fixed short lags only
difference: r(t-k)-r(t-k-1), short max k=8 needs <=9, all within H>=32

A2.note: harmonics are linear combinations of raw lags already present; extra columns change Ridge penalty, not the information set

alpha_selection: minimum online cold-start validation RMSE; exact ties prefer stronger alpha
history_sensitivity: validation-only best H reported, does not replace frozen primary H and is not scored on holdout
replication_gate: Rod2 validation only: A1 or A2 compared to A0 meets prespecified success; then replicate unchanged protocol on both Rod1 arms before any current holdout scoring

success.stable: criteria met on both validation and descriptive holdout

A2_extra_diagnostic_success: A2 meets same criteria vs A1 on validation and holdout while A1 has no stable success vs A0
cold_start: empty each split/entity/continuous segment, correction=0 first H rows, append current residual after feature construction
train: only saved prequential base OOF residuals, never base in-sample residuals

probe.train: A0 exact old saved probe; A1/A2 probe fit only another fixed-recipe prequential corrected residual stream

ACF: same centered biased segmented FFT as prior experiment; maxlag900
